note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for SC-200, 'Skills measured as of July 28, 2026'. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Manage a security operations environment
subtopics: Configure email and alert notifications in Microsoft Defender XDR, including tuning and suppression
Configure Defender for Endpoint advanced features, rules, and attack surface reduction
Manage automated investigation and response, and automatic attack disruption
Configure device groups, permissions, and automation levels
Create automation rules and playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel
Specify Sentinel roles and manage data retention across Analytics, Data lake, and XDR tiers
Select data connectors and configure AMA, WEF, Syslog, and CEF collection
Create analytics and custom detection rules, and map coverage with MITRE ATT&CK

domains.name: Respond to security incidents
subtopics: Investigate and remediate threats in Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps
Investigate compromised identities in Microsoft Entra ID and Defender for Identity
Investigate alerts from Defender for Cloud workload protections and Microsoft Purview
Investigate and remediate incidents in Microsoft Sentinel, including case management
Investigate complex multi-stage, multi-domain, and lateral-movement attacks
Investigate device timelines and perform live response on a device
Collect investigation packages and perform evidence and entity investigation
Investigate Microsoft 365 activity with Purview Audit, Content search, and Graph activity logs

domains.name: Perform threat hunting
subtopics: Identify the appropriate table for a KQL query and write Advanced Hunting queries
Interpret threat analytics in Microsoft Defender XDR
Create hunting graphs, including blast radius, and analyse entity relationships with Sentinel Graph
Create and monitor hunting queries in Microsoft Sentinel
Create and manage KQL jobs in the Data lake and summary rule tables
Hunt with notebooks, including a connection to the Sentinel MCP Server
